paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -1.70% on average, with Dow Jones strongest (+1.32%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-4.72%). Brent crude changed +3.81% to 114.05. Gold changed -3.90% to 4,017.8999. Bitcoin changed +0.17% to 81,521.3672. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.953%, a relative move of -2.67%. Among the firms tracked, Blackstone (+8.75%) and Ares Management (+8.48%) moved the most.
